title: Learn Swedish for everyday life | SvenskaVardag
text:
Want to learn Swedish for everyday life? 🇸🇪
SvenskaVardag has 58 short lessons, quick quizzes, a 1,304-word library and a fika card that fills up as you learn. Free, and no sign-in needed.

📝 "Hej! Jag heter Samira. Trevligt att träffas!"
↳ Hi! My name is Samira. Nice to meet you!

🎓 You get:
• 58 short lessons for real situations
• Quick quizzes to test yourself
• A 1,304-word library with audio
• A fika card that fills as you learn
